tool.name: Kong AI Gateway
tool.description: AI and MCP governance layer on Kong Gateway: multi-LLM routing, semantic caching, prompt guards, PII redaction and MCP OAuth.
strengths: Builds on existing Kong API gateway estates
Generates MCP servers from REST APIs
Token-based rate limiting and PII redaction
tool.licenseWarning: Open core: Kong Gateway and six basic AI plugins (ai-proxy, ai-prompt-guard, ai-prompt-decorator, ai-prompt-template, ai-request/response-transformer) are Apache 2.0, but advanced plugins such as AI Proxy Advanced and the MCP gateway features need the paid AI Gateway Enterprise offering.
tool.pricing: Konnect Plus from $25/month plus usage (AI Gateway plugins as add-ons, 5 LLMs included); semantic caching and prompt guards only in Enterprise (custom, annual).
tool.practitionerNote: Makes most sense if Kong already runs your API traffic, because AI and MCP policies reuse the same data plane and control plane. Budget for Enterprise: most advanced AI and MCP plugins are not in the OSS build.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Data planes run in customer infrastructure; Konnect control planes available in AU, EU, ME, US, IN and SG (beta) regions.

deployment.detail: Konnect SaaS control plane, self-hosted Kong Gateway Enterprise, or hybrid.

auditLogging.detail: Structured AI audit logs record payloads, token usage, model, latency, cost and guardrail block/mask outcomes; MCP traffic logging captures sessions and tool calls.

soc2.detail: Kong's trust center (trust.konghq.com) is JavaScript-rendered, and its certifications could not be read from a primary source in this review.

iso27001.detail: Kong's trust center could not be read from a primary source in this review.

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 claim found in the Kong sources reviewed.

euAiAct.detail: API/AI gateway infrastructure, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.

licenseRisk.detail: Open core: Apache 2.0 gateway, with key AI and MCP plugins available only in AI Gateway Enterprise.
